steps.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EXACT EDIT TARGET, one spring guardian bird sprite. Image 2 is a supporting low resting-tail reference. Fix TWO regions ONLY: the overly raised tail and the front/left crest feather. The head and torso are still just above final ground contact, as in image 1. Already lower the tail with gravity: all the long tail feathers trail back almost horizontally, uppermost tail tip no higher than the bird's green upper back. The lowest tips lie at the same ground baseline as the tucked feet. The very front/left crest feather bends forward down along the cream forehead and cheek, its tip hanging beside the beak rather than pointing up. Keep the tail roots visibly connected to the rump behind the folded green wing, with generous anatomical overlap; keep the left crest root attached to the scalp. Preserve the bird's head position, face and closed eye, cream torso, sage-green folded wing, coral/cream neck ruff, tucked gold feet, body proportions, illustration style, palette, line weight, original 576x576 logical framing and pivot (288,480) exactly as in image 1. Preserve the individual complete feather lobes and their existing color stripes. Do not move or resize the body to lower the tail. Feathers rest under their own weight; no rigid standing fan, hovering hooks, disconnected pieces, branching, holes, double outlines or motion blur. Transparent background, no ground plane or added shadow, no text. Output one full production sprite drawing on the same canvas.

Precise local edit of this existing transparent sprite. Change ONLY the frontmost far-left coral/cream head-crest feather. Its curled bottom tip is currently FLOATING next to the bird's forehead, above the beak. EXTEND AND LOWER THAT FEATHER DOWN so it drapes alongside the cheek and physically RESTS ON THE GROUND immediately to the LEFT of the beak. On the 1280 square source canvas, the bottom of that feather must reach y=1055 to 1070, the same horizontal baseline as the tucked feet and belly, instead of ending around y=1000. Flatten the last little curl gently along that baseline so the tip is supported and limp, not hooking upward into the air. The scalp root stays in exactly the same place; preserve continuous anatomical attachment and the feather's cream/coral stripe. Keep ALL other pixels/regions as close to the input as possible: the already LOW HORIZONTAL TAIL, other crest feathers, face, closed eye, beak, folded sage wing, cream belly, neck ruff, feet, body scale, exact position and canvas framing. Do not move the bird or ground baseline. No new feathers, no detached tip, no added shadow/ground/background/text. Transparent background. One full production sprite, identical 1280x1280 composition.
